validation_boundary: The authoritative ATOM Pydantic model, atom-kind sufficiency validator, serialization schema, and exact SEA v4 protocol were not directly retrievable. Structural and serialization checks therefore use a strict local Pydantic contract and generated JSON Schema reconstructed from current validated project LiteratureAtom outputs plus the supplied large-source consensus/guideline guardrail. This report does not claim execution of unavailable authoritative project code or the unavailable v4 numeric scoring rubric.

consistency_review.finding: One publication_id is preserved across all batches. Secondary trial summaries remain tagged as secondary reports. The supplement/main figure-number mismatch and GLP-1 terminology inconsistency are preserved as source-integrity issues.

schema_gaps: The authoritative project files literature.py, literature_atoms.py, and literature_atom.schema.json were searched in connected project sources but were not directly retrievable in this session.

The recovered LiteratureAtom pattern has no dedicated expert_consensus_recommendation or guideline_recommendation atom kind. Source advice is represented with author_conclusion or other and descriptive tags.
Trial effects reported by this ECDP are secondary-source summaries. They are tagged secondary_reported_result and are not represented as primary-study quantitative_result atoms.
extraction_limitations: This source is an expert consensus decision pathway, not a primary empirical study. ATOM extraction prioritizes the document's own consensus advice, definitions, methods, limitations, and selected secondary evidence summaries.
The 209-entry bibliography was exported separately and was not treated as evidence atoms.
All atoms remain needs_review because no human source-verification step is represented.
No external current-practice or regulatory verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
